acip: THUN MONG MA YIN PA GANG SNANG KUN BDE STONG DBYER MED DU 'CHAR BA LA SGRIB PA'I DRI MA 'KHRUD PAS YID DAG PAR BYED, 'OD GSAL PHYAG RGYA CHEN PO BSGOM PA LA DBANG BAR BYAS, 'BRAS BU CHOS KYI SKU MNGON DU GYUR BA'I NUS PA KHYAD PAR CAN 'JOG GO ,
wylie: thun mong ma yin pa gang snang kun bde stong dbyer med du 'char ba la sgrib pa'i dri ma 'khrud pas yid dag par byed, 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang bar byas, 'bras bu chos kyi sku mngon du gyur ba'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog go
english: The unique result of this initiation is that it purifies your mind, cleaning it of a special impurity: your tendency to be blinded to the fact that every single thing which ever appears to you is a manifestation of indivisible bliss and empitness.  You are, further, now empowered to engage in practices such as the Clear Light, and the Great Seal (Tantric Mahamudra).  Finally, an extraordinary seed has been planted within you which gives you the power to attain the final goal of the Dharma body.
